key_highlights: ASX suffered a major selloff with $169 billion wiped from the market amidst macro distress.
Debate escalates on whether RBA cash rate hikes have overtightened, severely hitting consumer borrowing power.
Accelerating residential property downturn, led by sharp price falls in Sydney and broader housing stress.
AUD drops significantly, impacting import costs while offering currency tailwinds to unhedged mining exporters.
Retail disruption intensifies as David Jones cuts 1,700 jobs and Myer gains market share, while Coles faces ACCC competition scrutiny.

sectors.trend: Mounting mortgage and margin headwinds due to compressed borrowing power and deep housing price falls, coupled with governance scrutiny at NAB.
sectors.implications: Elevated provisioning risk and slowing credit growth pressure bank valuations; governance issues at NAB compound sector sentiment.

sectors.trend: Weak AUD offsets broader market declines for bulk miners; strong exploratory and restart activity across gold and rare earths.
sectors.implications: Gold producers provide safe-haven appeal and operational restarts; mining juniors actively raise capital despite broad equity rout.

sectors.trend: Severe retail strain evidenced by mass layoffs at David Jones, Myer poaching market share, and Coles battling ACCC scrutiny alongside dietary GLP-1 shifts.
sectors.implications: Myer benefits tactically from department store consolidation; grocers face regulatory pressure and changing consumer baskets.

sectors.trend: Severe downturn across major housing markets, with Sydney price falls accelerating under the weight of cumulative rate hikes.
sectors.implications: Asset devaluations and high cost of capital continue to weigh heavily on residential developers and A-REIT balances.

sectors.trend: COP31 climate stalemates, grid stability concerns post-blackout, and mounting capital expenditure debate over Snowy Hydro 2.0.
sectors.implications: Policy uncertainty and project execution risks overhang both traditional energy names and clean transition infrastructure.

sectors.trend: Workforce rationalisation and hiring freezes driven by rapid AI integration alongside high private market AI valuations.
sectors.implications: Long-term operational efficiencies across enterprise sectors counterbalanced by near-term tech valuation headwinds from elevated interest rates.

key_themes: Aggressive RBA monetary tightening transmission hitting borrowing capacity and housing values.
Large-scale equity market de-risking following a $169 billion market capitalization wipeout.
AUD weakness offering selective currency insulation to USD-earning commodity exporters.
Retail and corporate restructuring accelerating amidst margin pressure and AI automation.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight residential property developers, non-bank lenders, and high-LVR mortgage exposures.
Maintain higher cash allocations and tilt toward defensive, non-discretionary sectors.
Hold unhedged offshore assets and commodity producers with USD-denominated revenues.
Diversify major bank holdings and monitor ongoing regulatory reviews into NAB payroll compliance.

opportunities.rationale: Gold serves as a key macro hedge during market downturns; low AUD expands margins for domestic producers restarting mines.
Myer is well-positioned to capture customer share, concessions, and suppliers from downsizing competitor David Jones.
BHP and Rio Tinto benefit from low AUD/USD realizations and robust balance sheets to withstand domestic equity turbulence.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce Exposure to Major Retail Banks
defensive_moves.rationale: Sharp declines in residential property values and crimped borrowing power elevate asset quality and margin risks.
A $169 billion market loss signals entrenched institutional selling and fragile technical market breadth.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight Supermarket Operators Facing Regulatory Scrutiny
defensive_moves.rationale: ACCC scrutiny on grocery margins and shifting food demand patterns present margin and valuation headwinds.

market_outlook.short_term: Cautious and defensive over 1–3 months; the ASX 200 faces persistent headwinds from housing stress and consumer retrenchment.
market_outlook.long_term: Neutral to constructive over 6–12 months as potential RBA easing and currency-driven commodity earnings support cyclical recovery.
key_catalysts: RBA monetary policy decisions and cash rate trajectory guidance
Quarterly Australian CPI and monthly inflation releases
National housing price index and mortgage delinquency prints
Employment and labor market softness indicators
China commodity demand and iron ore spot price resilience
watch_list: RBA cash rate target and policy commentary
Sydney and Melbourne property auction clearance rates and CoreLogic indices
ASX 200 (^AXJO) support bands and institutional equity volumes
ACCC regulatory determinations on supermarket competition
